Round 3 action. Need goods for later selling. Bribe to 1 for presidency next law? Holder 1 already president; bribing 1 gives influence to them — bribe gives sender influence, not receiver. Bribe 5M gives me +1 influence (influence counts toward presidency next law). Tie_order [1,2,0]; holder 1 with influence 1; if I get influence 2, I become president. Value: presidency gives veto/5% bonus. But 5M cost. Also cash rank matters (devaluation 62%).

Get goods: shuttle gives 3 goods, sellable round 4 for ~7-8 alashi each. That's ~20M value. Bribe 5M gives +1 influence — president control matters for law each round. I think shuttle best economically; influence via bribe 5M also strong (president + 5% bonus ~ 1.5M + veto control). Cash rank: I have 31M, bribing drops to 26M, still close to 25.5M of p1.

Shuttle: +3 goods → sell 3 next market at ~7 = 21M. That's better than 5M influence gain. Choose shuttle.
